get_random_torsions: generate a new molecular graph state with random torsion angles sampled uniformly from negative pi to positive pi
get_random_torsions_clone: clone a molecular graph and randomize its torsion angles then update atom positions accordingly
get_random_torsions_positions: update molecular atom positions by applying random torsion angles and centering by subtracting the center of mass
get_random_torsions_torch: use torch rand_like to sample random torsion angles for a batch of molecular graphs
get_random_torsions_batch: process a batch of molecular graphs by randomizing torsions and recentering positions per molecule
